item.title: AAA: Gas Prices Continue to Rise in Pa.
item.description: Gasoline demand is down, as fewer drivers hit the road during the recent winter storms. But this is the time of year when pump prices start nudging higher, as spring approaches and refineries start making the switch to summer-blend gasoline production.
